:::{#exm-roster-notation}
#### Rosters of vowels and odd integers
<!-- no-figure: a few written sets; nothing to plot -->

In [roster notation](#def-roster-notation),
the vowels of English are $\set{a, e, i, o, u}$,
and the [odd integers](number-systems.qmd#def-odd) from $1$ to $99$
are $\set{1, 3, 5, \ldots, 99}$,
where the ellipsis stands for the odd integers from $7$ to $97$.
Listing an element twice does not add an element:
$\set{a, a, e}$ and $\set{a, e}$ are the same [set](#def-set),
since they have the same elements.

:::
